predecessors.name: Pala Empire
predecessors.text: Tirhut or Mithila in Bihar, with the Simraungadh country on the Nepal border

successors.name: Tughlaq dynasty
successors.text: Tirhut or Mithila in Bihar, with the Simraungadh country on the Nepal border

ledger.x: 10 July 1097: Nanyadeva takes the land at Simraungadh. an inscribed pillar at Simraungadh records that "king Nānyadeva took the land" in the Śaka year 1019, equated by the page with 10 July 1097; the dynasty was "established in 1097 CE by Nanyadeva".
1324: the Karnat kingdom of Mithila ends.

wars.name: Karnat-Sena conflict over Gauda and Mithila
wars.outcome: The Karnats and Senas "coveted the Pala territories of Gauda and Vanga"; "the Senas coming out victorious as per the Deopara inscription"; parts of Mithila later fell under Sena control and were regained by Gangadeva.

wars.name: Tughluq conquest of Tirhut
wars.outcome: Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq advanced on Simraungarh while marching on Bengal; Harisimhadeva fled into Nepal.

certainty.note: No frontier is given; Tirhut / Mithila is the only land the pages name.
